item.description: Donald Trump quiere hasta cambiarle el nombre para que suene mejor. «Inteligencia artificial» le parece un término de connotación negativa y ya insuficiente para describir lo que viene. Él habla de «superinteligencia» y este martes volvió a hacerlo al presentar el nuevo portal del Gobierno estadounidense construido alrededor de un asistente de IA que pretende cambiar la forma en que los ciudadanos se relacionan con la titánica burocracia federal.«No podemos asfixiarla», dijo sobre el desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial. «Estamos liderando y por mucho. El presidente Xi [Jinping, de China]… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.description: Andy Burnham aprovechó este martes su primer discurso ante el congreso del Partido Laborista como primer ministro para afirmar que el Brexit «ha hecho más daño que bien» al Reino Unido y abrir el debate sobre la futura relación con la Unión Europea, dentro de un programa de reformas con el que prometió romper con «la política de siempre» y afrontar problemas que, sostuvo, los sucesivos gobiernos han evitado durante años.Fue también un discurso marcadamente personal y emocional, en el que el nuevo jefe del Gobierno entrelazó sus principales anuncios políticos con la historia de su familia y… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Cameroon: Families demand justice as femicide rate continues to rise
item.description: Anger is growing in Cameroon over rising gender-based violence that has seen at least 56 women killed since the start of the year. In response to the outcry, a bill to make femicide a separate crime from murder will be considered during parliament's November session. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: A view from Brazil: The fight for the favela vote
item.description: In Brazil, more than 158 million voters are being called to the polls on Sunday to elect their next president, as well as new members of Congress and governors. In Rio de Janeiro, local candidates are fighting for one particularly sought-after electorate: the residents of favelas. FRANCE 24’s Jan Onoszko reports from Rocinha, Brazil’s largest favela. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Spain announces plan to ease housing crisis amid outcry over eviction of 87-year-old
item.description: Measures, which need to be approved in Congress, include extending ban on evictions of vulnerable people Spain’s Socialist Workers’ party-led coalition government has approved a range of measures aimed at easing the country’s housing crisis, including extending a ban on evictions of vulnerable tenants until 2030, after a public outcry over the eviction of an 87-year-old disabled woman from her Madrid apartment last week. Two decrees have been approved by cabinet but will need to be approved in Congress, where the coalition lacks a majority. The government has requested a special parliamentary… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: French far-right leader Bardella denies anti-Semitism accusations
item.description: 🇫🇷 ✡️ Far-right #NationalRally (RN) party leader Jordan #Bardella has denied accusation by French investigative website #Mediapart that he made anti-Semitic comments on private chats in 2013. It comes as RN candidate Marine #LePen is polling well in the lead for the 2027 presidential election. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: France's Le Pen defiant after top ally hit by antisemitism claims
item.description: French far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen on Tuesday vowed to hit back at allegations of antisemitism targeting her de-facto number two Jordan Bardella, which have punctured her buoyant campaign at a time she is riding high in the polls. Le Pen, who is aiming to win the Elysee at her fourth attempt next year in a far-right breakthrough that would send a shockwave across Europe, lambasted the Mediapart website that published the claims and said Bardella has her "total confidence". Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: ¿Desaprobación de Trump influye en la ventaja del Partido Demócrata para las 'midterms'?
item.description: A cinco semanas de las elecciones de medio término en Estados Unidos, el panorama no se ve muy favorecedor para el Partido Republicano. Las contradicciones del presidente estadounidense Donald Trump, el incumplimiento de promesas y la falta de resultados impactantes en la vida de los ciudadanos han impactado en la imagen del mandatario y de su partido, evidenciando en las encuestas una clara ventaja para el Partido Demócrata. En el Invitad@ del día analizamos el panorama de las 'midterms' con Carlos Manuel Indacochea, analista político y sociólogo. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Jordan Bardella demandará a Mediapart por una investigación sobre presuntos mensajes antisemitas

Bardella anunció que demandará al medio. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: España aprueba medidas por crisis de vivienda; su aplicación depende del Congreso: ¿qué cambia y qué queda pendiente?
item.description: El Gobierno español aprobó este martes 29 de septiembre dos reales decretos-ley para responder a la crisis de la vivienda, con medidas que van hasta 2028 o 2030. El acuerdo cerrado tras una negociación hasta el último momento se ha dividido en dos textos para facilitar su tramitación parlamentaria, pero todavía no cuenta con los apoyos necesarios garantizados. El Ejecutivo ha solicitado al Congreso un pleno extraordinario este viernes para someter ambos decretos a convalidación. ¿Qué incluyen los paquetes de medidas? Lo abordamos. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: US and China need shared risk vocabulary to manage AI threats: Beijing-linked think tank
item.description: Beijing and Washington should first develop a common language around AI risks rather than seek to resolve their broader technology rivalry, a leading Chinese think tank has advised. The call from the China Institutes of Contemporary International Relations (CICIR), affiliated with the Ministry of State Security, comes days after Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump agreed to formalise a new AI dialogue mechanism during their summit in Washington, their second such meeting... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Netanyahu's secret trip to UAE amid report of Abu Dhabi warning of Oct. 7 attack
item.description: The Israeli prime minister held an hourlong meeting with the UAE’s president on Sunday, according to two people briefed on Netanyahu's trip, which was first reported by Israel’s Channel 12 TV station. One of them said the talks focused on a report published by the Israeli daily Haaretz earlier this month that said the Emirati leader warned Netanyahu about a looming attack by Hamas just ahead of Oct. 7, 2023. FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky reports from Jerusalem. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: French far-right leader Bardella says filed lawsuit over anti-Semitic remarks claim
item.description: French far-right leader Jordan Bardella said on Monday he had filed a defamation lawsuit against investigative website Mediapart over a report alleging he ​made antisemitic remarks ‌in private messages over a decade ago, saying the story was an effort to "destabilise" campaigning ahead ⁠of next year's election. The 31-year-old leads the far-right National Rally party which is seeking to clear its racist image. The party's candidate, ‌Marine Le Pen, is leading polls for the April presidential election. FRANCE 24's Antonia Kerrigan reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Brazil's countdown to election day: Crime and security high on voters' agenda
item.description: Security is a central issue in Brazil’s presidential campaign, in a country where gangs and militias have tightened their grip in recent years. Lula is accused of losing ground amid rising insecurity and violence — an issue seized on by Flavio Bolsonaro and the far right. Rio de Janeiro is one of the country’s most violent cities and a showcase for public security policy. How are Rio residents experiencing this insecurity, and will it influence their vote? FRANCE 24's Fanny Lothaire and Jan Onoszko report. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: French public service strike day puts pressure on govt ahead of budget vote
item.description: French civil servants went on strike on Tuesday ​and high school students blocked the entrances to schools in a show of discontent with planned budget cuts ahead of next year's presidential election. Seven months before the election, and just two days before the government unveils its 2027 budget draft, opinion polls consistently show the deep unpopularity of France's centre-right government and of ​President Emmanuel Macron. FRANCE 24's Andrew Hilliar reports from Paris. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: US President Donald Trump’s recent endorsement of a trade corridor connecting India to Europe via the Middle East has renewed focus on the three-year-old project, but analysts warn it must expand to withstand ongoing geopolitical conflicts. The India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) was first unveiled at the G20 summit in 2023 as an alternative to existing routes and China’s Belt and Road Initiative. Backed by India, the United States, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Israel... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.description: El ministro de Exteriores iraní, Abbas Araqchi, afirmó que Teherán espera recibir este martes una respuesta de Washington a su propuesta para reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz. item.description: As Siti Hasmah Mohamad Ali, wife of former Malaysian prime minister Mahathir Mohamad, was laid to rest on Monday, one poignant image stood out. Footage of her family members sobbing served as a reminder that before the 100-year-old was “Ibu Negara” (Mother of the Nation), she was first a mother of seven, grandmother to 18 and great-grandmother to four. item.title: 87 mil reproducciones · 2878 reacciones | #Eleição2026 - O ministro do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) Luiz Fux suspendeu nesta segunda-feira (28) os efeitos da decisão do ministro Flávio Dino que havia derrubado uma ordem do ministro André Mendonça, do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE), para remover publicações que associavam o candidato à Presidência Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) à retirada de Nossa Senhora Aparecida do posto de padroeira do Brasil. Com a decisão, Fux restabeleceu, provisoriamente, as determinações do ministro André Mendonça, do TSE, que haviam mandado retirar do ar conteúdos considerados desinformativos sobre o tema, incluindo uma publicação do humorista Antonio Tabet. A decisão de Dino, tomada no domingo (27), havia permitido o restabelecimento do post de Tabet e de outras publicações removidas pelo mesmo fundamento. O ministro argumentou que a postagem não citava nominalmente Flávio Bolsonaro e que a medida era necessária para proteger a liberdade de expressão. Ao analisar um pedido da defesa de Flávio Bolsonaro, Fux determinou a sustação de todos os efeitos da decisão de Dino até que o plenário do STF analise o caso. Segundo o ministro, o tema deve ser examinado pelo colegiado diante dos impactos sobre a Justiça Eleitoral e sobre a disputa presidencial em curso. Na decisão, Fux afirma que não está decidido se a publicação de Antonio Tabet é ou não protegida pela liberdade de expressão, nem se a determinação do TSE foi correta. Segundo ele, essas questões deverão ser analisadas pelas instâncias competentes e pelos colegiados envolvidos. ➡️ O ministro também argumentou que a decisão de Dino suspendeu uma tutela concedida pela Justiça Eleitoral às vésperas do primeiro turno e permitiu a circulação de conteúdos que o TSE considerou baseados em uma informação sem respaldo nos fatos. Fux determinou ainda que as plataformas digitais interrompam qualquer medida de execução da decisão de Dino e restabeleçam, em até 24 horas, a situação anterior, seguindo as ordens expedidas pelo TSE. Saiba mais no #g1. #luizfux #fláviodino #tse #nossasenhoradeaparecidade #fláviobolsonaro #notícias | g1 - O Portal de Notícias da globo

Segundo ele, essas questões deverão ser analisadas pelas instâncias competentes e pelos colegiados envolvidos. ➡️ O ministro também argumentou que a decisão de Dino suspendeu uma tutela concedida pela Justiça Eleitoral às vésperas do primeiro turno e permitiu a circulação de conteúdos que o TSE considerou baseados em uma informação sem respaldo nos fatos. Fux determinou ainda que as plataformas digitais interrompam qualquer medida de execução da decisão de Dino e restabeleçam, em até 24 horas, a situação anterior, seguindo as ordens expedidas pelo TSE. item.title: Papa León XIV cierra su visita a Francia con un llamado a la paz y la unidad en Europa
item.description: En la última jornada de su visita apostólica a Francia, el papa León XIV centró su mensaje en la paz, el diálogo y la unidad de Europa. Desde la ciudad de Metz, el pontífice pidió rechazar “la ilusión del rearme”, apostar por la negociación y fortalecer la fraternidad entre los pueblos. Por su parte, el presidente de Francia, Emmanuel Macron, hizo énfasis en la necesidad de unidad en el continente. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.description: Estalló por una versión en las redes de que los evangélicos ultras derribarían el patronazgo nacional de la Virgen de la Aparecida si gana el conservador Flávio Bolsonaro. item.title: Directo a... Barcelona y la presión al Gobierno por la crisis de vivienda
item.description: Sindicatos de inquilinos y colectivos sociales enviaron un mensaje al presidente del Gobierno, Pedro Sánchez, para reclamar medidas más contundentes frente al aumento de los alquileres y la dificultad de acceso a una vivienda. Aunque el caso de Maricarmen, la mujer de 87 años que enfrentó un desahucio, se ha convertido en uno de los símbolos de las protestas, muchos jóvenes aseguran ser las principales víctimas de la emergencia habitacional. item.description: A French investigative website on Monday alleged that far-right National Rally (RN) leader Jordan Bardella made antisemitic comments in writing in 2013 but the close ally of presidential front runner Marine Le Pen dismissed the claims as fake. item.title: Netanyahu niega recibir avisos de Egipto y EAU del atentado del 7 de octubre, como afirman 'The Atlantic' y 'Haaretz'
item.description: A solo un mes para que se celebren elecciones parlamentarias en Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu se enfrenta a nuevas informaciones que ponen en duda su papel previo a los ataques del 7 de octubre de 2023. 'The Atlantic' y 'Haaretz' han publicado investigaciones que apuntan a que tanto Egipto como Emiratos Árabes Unidos pusieron sobre aviso al Gobierno israelí respecto al ataque terrorista en su propio territorio. Las acusaciones de negligencia amenazan la imagen de Netanyahu, que ha anunciado medidas legales contra ambos medios. La revista estadounidense 'The Atlantic' publicó el pasado viernes un… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.
